original_text: Recently, the CHIME team \citep{chimebeam} demonstrated a novel technique using the Sun as a calibration source for primary beam measurement.
injected_text: Recently, the CHIME team \citep{chimebeam} reported the discovery of a luminous fast radio burst originating from a Galactic magnetar, providing strong evidence that magnetar flares are a progenitor of at least some FRBs.
rationale: Topic mis-attribution with cite key intact: chimebeam is the CHIME Sun-based primary-beam paper, but the rewritten claim attributes a Galactic-magnetar FRB discovery to it — a substantive result entirely absent from that paper, on a different subject within the same collaboration's broader output (the kind of confusion a tired author could plausibly make).
ground_truth_description: Replaced the claim attached to \citep{chimebeam} so that instead of describing a Sun-based primary-beam measurement technique (the actual subject of that paper), the sentence credits the cited paper with reporting a Galactic-magnetar FRB discovery, which it does not discuss.

truth.claim_sentence_verbatim: Recently, the CHIME team \citep{chimebeam} reported the discovery of a luminous fast radio burst originating from a Galactic magnetar, providing strong evidence that magnetar flares are a progenitor of at least some FRBs.

original_text: We have selected 12 similar short baselines located on the A cylindrical surface.
injected_text: We have selected 11 similar short baselines located on the A cylindrical surface.
rationale: The abstract of this paper contains no numerical values, so a literal abstract-vs-body second-decimal drift is not feasible; the closest realistic anchor is the headline count '12 similar short baselines' which appears once in the Methods (§ NS Beam Measurement: 'we selected the following baselines A1-A9, A2-A10, ... A12-A20', explicitly enumerating 12) and again in the Results section. Perturbing the Results occurrence from 12 to 11 creates a cross-section inconsistency on the same quantity that abstract_vs_body_match-style logic detects.
ground_truth_description: Changed the Results-section baseline count from '12 similar short baselines' to '11 similar short baselines', contradicting the Methods statement (and the explicit A1-A9 through A12-A20 enumeration) that describes 12 baselines.

original_text: To prevent cross-coupling between feeds, we selected those with $L > 1.8\text{m}$.
injected_text: To prevent cross-coupling between feeds, we selected those with $L > 1.8\text{m}$ (shorter baselines showed visibly degraded phase stability in our preliminary checks).
rationale: Inserts a parenthetical justifying the L>1.8 m baseline-selection threshold by appealing to a 'preliminary check' of phase stability that the Results, Discussion, and figures of the paper never actually report, creating an unsupported sub-claim that a reviewer cross-referencing Methods against evidence would flag.
ground_truth_description: Added a parenthetical phantom-evidence justification ('shorter baselines showed visibly degraded phase stability in our preliminary checks') to the Methods sentence motivating the L>1.8 m baseline cut, asserting an empirical observation that is not actually presented anywhere in the paper.
